description: Default (kappa, beta, eta, xi) for the 2D SLCD sanity check. These values are chosen so that (a) p=0 recovers v1 bit-exact, (b) an interior Nash in (c*, p*) exists for the validated SLCD parameters (theta=20, gamma=0.65, alpha=[0.55,0.45], D=[[0,0.64],[0.86,0]]), and (c) appropriation is a plausible but not dominant strategy.

semantics.kappa: linear cost of appropriation effort (resource diverted from endowment)
semantics.beta: commons-erosion coefficient; synergy is scaled by (1 - beta * mean(p))
semantics.eta: appropriation conversion rate; fraction of joint surplus captured per unit p
semantics.xi: convex cost coefficient on p_i^2 (prevents bang-bang solutions)

notes: Calibration is deliberately coarse. Fine-tuning to the SLCD 2004-2011 dissolution timeline is a follow-up task.
The 58/60 rubric must continue to hold when p is clamped to 0; see tests/test_backward_compat.py.
